messages.content: Audit the skills currently visible to this session. First call skill.list with category set to the empty string, then call it with no category, then with category __missing_catalog_probe__. These deliberately supplied inputs exercise discovery, not skill execution. Explain whether the first two return the same names/count and whether the last means an empty catalog or an unmatched category. Use tool results rather than guessing from the prompt index; do not edit skills or inspect personal state. Return the observed counts and a brief interpretation.

Stopped retrying after 6 consecutive iterations without new execution evidence. Earlier work is preserved. Ask to continue so the remaining work can resume with corrected arguments or a different approach.
